findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Меню" above "Избери своя вкус"; "Промоции" above "Специални оферти"; "-10%" above "Първа поръчка"; "-15%" above "Вечерно Drive Combo"; "Ново" above "Truffle Noir седмица"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 22 gradient fill(s): div.site-experience.lily-experience → radial-gradient(70vw 45vw at 88% -8%, rgba(255, 128, 30, 0.16), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 62%), radial-gradient(55vw 45 | a.food-card-photo → radial-gradient(70% 70% at 50% 45%, rgba(255, 140, 40, 0.28), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), none | a.food-card-photo → radial-gradient(70% 70% at 50% 45%, rgba(255, 140, 40, 0.28), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), none
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 53 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn-primary → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(255, 120, 20, 0.65) 0px 14 | article.food-card.group → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0px 24px 50p | button.food-add-button → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(255, 120, 20, 0.8) 0px 10p
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header.lily-home-header 1440px | div.hero-caption 1344px | div.eg-marquee 1440px | section#how-it-works.relative.scroll-mt-20 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: No headline found in the first viewport.
findings.fix: The first screen needs a clear focal statement or image.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 9 different lines (96px, 115px, 433px, 751px, 871px, 1069px, 129px); the three most used hold only 50% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Четири стъпки до вашата поръчка" (screen 8, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
